original.name: intervalCutoff
original.header: private def intervalCutoff (a b r : ℝ) : ℝ

original.name: intervalCutoff_smooth
original.header:
private theorem intervalCutoff_smooth (a b : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 1 (intervalCutoff a b)

original.name: intervalCutoff_range
original.header:
private theorem intervalCutoff_range (a b r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ intervalCutoff a b r ∧ intervalCutoff a b r ≤ 1

original.name: intervalCutoff_left
original.header: private theorem intervalCutoff_left (a b : ℝ) : intervalCutoff a b a = 0

original.name: intervalCutoff_right
original.header: private theorem intervalCutoff_right (a b : ℝ) : intervalCutoff a b (b+1) = 0

original.name: intervalCutoff_one
original.header:
private theorem intervalCutoff_one {a b r : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Icc (a+1) b) :
    intervalCutoff a b r = 1

original.name: intervalCutoff_deriv
original.header:
private theorem intervalCutoff_deriv (a b r : ℝ) :
    deriv (intervalCutoff a b) r =
      deriv Real.smoothTransition (r-a)*Real.smoothTransition (b+1-r) -
        Real.smoothTransition (r-a)*deriv Real.smoothTransition (b+1-r)

original.name: intervalCutoff_deriv_bound
tail_continuity
finite_derivative_bound
original.header:
private theorem finite_derivative_bound {tau R a C : ℝ} {u : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hu : TailSolution tau R u) (hRa : R < a) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hCbound : ∀ r : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition r| ≤ C)
    (hL2 : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioi R)))
    {b : ℝ} (hab : a+1 ≤ b) :
    (∫ r in (a+1)..b, Complex.normSq (deriv u r)) ≤
      (16*C^2+2*tau^2)*(∫ r in Ioi R, Complex.normSq (u r))

original.name: derivative_memLp_two_smaller_tail
original.header:
theorem derivative_memLp_two_smaller_tail {tau R : ℝ} {u : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hu : TailSolution tau R u)
    (hL2 : MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (Ioi R))) :
    MemLp (deriv u) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioi (R+2)))
